hero.title:
Two brothers.
One shared standard.
hero.description: SK Event Hire began with a simple idea: bring the care, reliability and trust of a close family partnership into every event.
hero.imageAlt: Sekar and Kajan preparing an SK Event Hire celebration together

meaning.title: S is Sekar. K is Kajan.
paragraphs: Sekar—also known as Shiva—and Kajan are brothers and the founders behind SK Event Hire. The brand name combines the first letter of each brother’s name: S from Sekar and K from Kajan.
They created the platform to offer practical, dependable event hire supported by clear communication, prepared products and responsible service.

principles.eyebrow: WHAT THE STORY MEANS IN PRACTICE
principles.title: A relationship translated into reliable service.
principles.description: The story matters because it shapes how the company works—not because it needs to be overstated.
items: Solve problems as one connected team.
Treat every customer’s event as important.
Say what is confirmed and what still needs checking.

origin.imageAlt: SK Event Hire equipment being checked before an event
origin.eyebrow: FROM A FAMILY IDEA TO EVENT HIRE
origin.title: Built around helping people come together.
paragraphs: Sekar and Kajan created the SK brand together. Event hire was a practical direction because successful functions depend on preparation, teamwork and reliable service.
Today that principle appears in practical details—clean equipment, clear quotations, careful delivery planning and a team that takes ownership from first enquiry to final collection.
origin.quote: SK is not a slogan. It is a reminder to work with the loyalty, honesty and care expected between brothers.

timeline.title: How the idea became a working platform.
items: Two brothers and close friends supporting one another.
S comes from Sekar and K comes from Kajan: a clear identity for the business they created together.
Build a dependable event-hire service that helps people gather.
Connect products, planning, quotations, checkout and support clearly.

final.title: The story continues through the work.
final.description: Every prepared chair, confirmed delivery window and completed setup is another opportunity to live up to the name.
final.imageAlt: Completed event prepared by SK Event Hire
